title: Making a file on a disk
question: The same create, on ext4: what does a disk file system keep track of?
text: Call 1, [fd = openat(AT_FDCWD, "/mnt/new.txt", O_CREAT | O_WRONLY, 0644)](1): [ext4_create](1:ext4_create) ext4 makes the file, all in one journal transaction (so a crash leaves all of it, or none). [__ext4_new_inode](1:__ext4_new_inode) A free inode for it: found in a block group's inode bitmap, and marked used. [add_dirent_to_buf](1:add_dirent_to_buf) The name "new.txt": into free space in a block of the directory, next to the other names.
